title: Keeping time with the foot
summary: Metoyer's French method taught foot-tapping as an imaginary needle for time. Ernie compares his two-beat down-and-up system with other teachers' four-beat counts.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
